mapper.select: SELECT la.linked_account_id, la.user_id, la.bank_code, b.bank_name, b.bank_logo_name, la.account_number, la.account_holder, la.primary_yn, la.connection_status, COALESCE(ad.balance, ad2.balance, 510000) AS balance FROM linked_account_tbl la INNER JOIN bank_tbl b ON la.bank_code = b.bank_code LEFT JOIN account_dummy_tbl ad ON la.account_number = ad.account_number LEFT JOIN account_dummy_tbl ad2 ON la.user_id = ad2.user_id AND la.bank_code = ad2.bank_code WHERE la.user_id = #{userId} AND la.connection_status = 'CONNECTED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN la.primary_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, la.linked_account_id

SELECT la.linked_account_id, la.user_id, la.bank_code, b.bank_name, b.bank_logo_name, la.account_number, la.account_holder, la.primary_yn, la.connection_status FROM linked_account_tbl la INNER JOIN bank_tbl b ON la.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE la.user_id = #{userId} AND la.linked_account_id = #{linkedAccountId} AND la.connection_status = 'CONNECTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linked_account_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND connection_status = 'CONNECTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_tbl WHERE bank_code = #{bankCode} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_verification_tbl ( user_id, bank_code, account_number, account_holder, verification_code, verified_yn, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bankCode}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, #{verificationCode}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, user_id, bank_code, account_number, account_holder, verification_code, verified_yn, requested_at, fail_count, resend_count, locked_until FROM account_verification_tbl WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT verification_id, user_id, bank_code, account_number, account_holder, verification_code, verified_yn, requested_at, fail_count, resend_count, locked_until FROM account_verification_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_code = #{bankCode} AND account_number = #{accountNumber} ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE account_verification_tbl SET verification_code = #{verificationCode}, fail_count = 0, resend_count = resend_count + 1, requested_at = NOW() WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND resend_count < 1

UPDATE linked_account_tbl SET primary_yn = 'N', connection_status = 'DISCONNECTED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND linked_account_id = #{linkedAccountId} AND connection_status = 'CONNECTED'
mapper.select: SELECT la.linked_account_id, la.user_id, la.bank_code, b.bank_name, b.bank_logo_name, la.account_number, la.account_holder, la.primary_yn, la.connection_status FROM linked_account_tbl la INNER JOIN bank_tbl b ON la.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE la.user_id = #{userId} AND la.linked_account_id != #{linkedAccountId} AND la.connection_status = 'CONNECTED' ORDER BY la.linked_account_id LIMIT 1
